name: Adductor-Related Groin Pain
definition: Groin pain reproduced by adductor palpation and resisted adduction, often occurring in athletes and requiring differentiation from hip, inguinal and pubic causes.

investigations.MRI: MRI/ultrasound can help when symptoms persist or diagnosis is uncertain.

amber: Surgery or injection is rarely first-line and depends on confirmed structural pathology.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vankshana/Snayu musculoskeletal phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Groin pain reproduced by adductor palpation and resisted adduction, often occurring in athletes and requiring differentiation from hip, inguinal and pubic causes.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
